attBesluta.text: Es justo lo que me esperaba, funciona perfectamente.

Ieder jaar moet ik een handmatig te bedienen flexibele veer huren om mijn afvoer van 70 mm te ontstoppen. Dat werkt goed maar kost geld maar als het verhuurbedrijf gesloten is of de veer al verhuurd is heb je een probleem. Ik heb deze machine gekocht om deze altijd bij de hand te hebben en het werkt perfect. Door de 4 meter verlengstukken van in totaal 20 meter weet je ook waar je bent in de afvoer. Er zitten verschillende koppen bij en daardoor kon ik in het eerste deel van de leiding boomwortels eruit halen zonder deze door te duwen. Voor de rest kon ik dan weer de normale kop gebruiken. Voor de 40 mm aansluiting op die 70 mm afvoer kon ik de dunne veer gebruiken wat ook goed heeft gewerkt. Mooie set voor alle verstoppingen dus. De veer is van veerstaal en begint bijna gelijk te roesten na gebruik in de afvoer en daarom kun je het beste na gebruik de veer insmeren met een in olie gedrenkte doek. Dan is hij volgend jaar weer klaar voor gebruik.

A bit challenging to put together solo but doable. Take your time. Sturdy. I wanted it for my bedroom so I can move bedside if reading in bed or roll it to a neighboring room. I wish the side pocket was wider to hold a magazine. The cart itself holds a fairly good number of books and reading material yet takes up very little space. I think a homeschooling family would find it useful!

Much sturdier than I expected. The rolling bookshelf is made of a nice powder coated steel. It should be able hold a good amount of books. It will help organize the stacks of books that would be better suited on a shelf. It says you need two people to assemble, and it would definitely be easier that way, but I was able to do it myself in about 15-20 mins. The back panels needed a little persuasion to get the holes lines up, but nothing crazy. I see why they say to not tighten the bolts until you put it all together. Vevor is at least a recognizable Chinese brand that seems to sell everything. I have had good experiences with their customer service on other products, and expect the same here.

I chose the VEVOR Rolling Library Book Cart to help control my office chaos. I LOVE this cart! It is so sturdy and it is pretty heavy. The instructions state 2 people are needed to build it but I was able to do it solo in about 20 minutes. This is an awesome value for the price!
Generally good quality however could use latching system to keep it from collapsing during use.

The “Beach Dolly” is a good-quality product. The only problem I have is that it is difficult to move through sand. I believe 12-inch inflatable wheels would work much better for this purpose. I would greatly appreciate it if VEVOR would allow me to replace the current 9-inch wheels with 12-inch inflatable wheels. I am willing to return the 9-inch wheels in their original, unused condition and pay the price difference for the 12-inch inflatable wheels. Please let me know if this replacement is possible. Thank you for your consideration.

He comprado varias por asunto de trabajo y tengo que decir que son una protección fabulosa no solo para pagar algún incendio sino que también para resguardar a mi maquinaria de temperaturas altas como las de este verano por ejemplo y para evitar algún incendio cuando no quede otra opción y se trabaja con herramientas que produzcan algún tipo de chispa.

Ordered these for an eccentric use--to hang in front of garage doors during the winter to provide a few more "R's" of insulation...they are the perfect size for 9 x 7 doors. They seem to block air penetration fairly well, and they add a pocket of air between the door and the room. While they are not entirely opaque, you cannot clearly see what is happening inside when peering outside through the garage windows like a creep. One of the grommets was held on with a thread and came off with very little stress...-1 star on the "quality" metric. Cannot speak to the blankets' advertised uses...but the entire experience was painless and I ended up with what I wanted at a reasonable cost with fast shipping. Thanks again, ‹NAMN›!
